question: NHL 2026-27 regular-season national TV average viewership exceeds 510K per game (i.e., maintains ≥93% of the 14-year-high 2025-26 baseline of 546K)
resolution_criterion: Per Nielsen / Sportico published 2026-27 NHL season summary, average national TV viewership per game ≥ 510,000 viewers across Disney + TNT Sports networks combined
